source.verbatim_statement: In the remainder of the paper, just for the sake of brevity, we focus on the minimisation problem, noticing that the maximisation counterpart can be handled analogously. Theorem 1: Eq. (3) with \(M=M_{\sigma}\) gives the same minimum of Eq. (4). Theorem 3: The LP task in Eq. (9) gives the solution of Eq. (4). Furthermore, there exists an SCM \(\mathcal M\in\mathbb M_{\sigma}\) such that \(P_{\mathcal M}(\gamma)\) coincides with the solution of the LP. Signature states that evaluate identically against these observations and events can be grouped into equivalence classes. Theorem 4: The lifted LP task in Eq. (11) gives the solution of Eq. (4). Furthermore, there exists an SCM \(\mathcal M\in\mathbb M_{\sigma}\) such that \(P_{\mathcal M}(\gamma)\) coincides with the solution of the LP.

proposed_statement_changes.reason: The exact \(h-1\) exponents silently require a retained factual-equivalent block, but \(\mathcal H\) is not augmented by \(\varnothing\). For \(h=2\), two contexts can share a nonfactual prefix, one can intervene at the next coordinate, and the other can remain natural, producing two necessary single-conjunction representatives, which exceeds \(3^{1/3}\). With a ternary alphabet and one live natural-world test, the joint transition has three necessary partition-plus-flag successors, which exceeds \(2^{1}\). Summing branching-block sizes only yields \(h\), giving the honest exact counts \(3^{h/3}\) and \((r+1)^h\). The downstream advertised compiler runtimes are unchanged because the first difference is a constant factor and the second is one factor \(r+1\), polynomial in the explicit input length.

proposed_core_edits.reason: A normalized conjunction may be empty or reduce to a truth constant, so its exact retained context set may be empty. The cardinality \(h=|\mathcal H|\) must therefore admit zero; the compiler proofs cover \(h=0\), while results explicitly quantified over positive \(h\) remain unchanged.

proposed_core_edits.name: gammasep
proposed_core_edits.reason: As frozen, the separation conjunction mentions only \(A\) and \(B\), so exact normalization produces \(\{A,B\}\), not the declared \(\mathcal H_n^{\mathrm{sep}}=\{\varnothing,A,B\}\). Adding the factual atom \(S_{\varnothing}=0\) makes normalization retain exactly the declared three contexts. It is redundant on the fixed factual-zero fibre and therefore preserves every feasible history and the claimed separation.
Wire finite explicit alphabet support directly into the preprocessing proof, which constructs membership tries and charges their input scan.

proposed.justification: This lemma makes the predecessor-only compiler interface an explicit value-preserving reduction rather than a silent syntactic assumption.
proposed.gap: The order-only response-signature literature permits general intervention atoms, while the continuation proof needs a normalized predecessor-only retained dialect; the exact preprocessing contract is not part of the equality-partition result.
proposed.consumer: Every compiler theorem can measure the context parameter on the smaller normalized context set while preserving the input query value.

proposed.justification: The sourced equivalence licenses the compiler's saturated response carrier while keeping the target class equal to standard order-compatible recursive models with parent subsets.
proposed.gap: Rossetto--Antonucci supply this equivalence; it is an imported interface fact and carries no novelty claim.
proposed.consumer: The endpoint theorems can optimize over complete-predecessor response rows without redefining an arbitrary recursive structural causal model as saturated.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Wire the published response-signature sharpness and quotient interface into the theorem's explicit comparison with Rossetto--Antonucci.

proposed.justification: The theorem gives an exact sharp-bound routine whose exponential factor depends on the normalized world count rather than alphabet cardinality.
proposed.gap: Rossetto--Antonucci's exact lifted program retains an alphabet-product optimization space; this theorem is a strict computational tightening on the same order-only model and conjunction target.
proposed.consumer: Sharp probabilities of necessity, sufficiency, and other explicit multi-world conjunctions become tractable when the normalized number of contexts is small even with many-valued variables.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Wire the finite complete carrier and factual-fibre definition directly into the proof of exact terminal support and cellwise endpoint attainment.

proposed.justification: Joint flags preserve cross-term dependence while sparse cellwise witnesses turn exact normalized feasibility into sharp partial identification.
proposed.gap: Existing sharp response-signature and canonical polynomial programs do not give this alphabet-independent joint compiler.
